capabilities: Overlay color-coded recency indicators next to file titles in the explorer
Encode file age with a 30-day color scale and weekly bar widths
Show exact day counts on files modified within 15 days
Toggle the heatmap overlay with a configurable hotkey
Customize colors, bar widths, and thresholds in settings
disambiguation: Not a vault-wide activity graph like a GitHub contribution heatmap; it only places per-file indicators next to titles in the file explorer.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is available in English and Japanese.
motivation: The author built it to eliminate the friction of checking recently changed files, replacing disruptive tricks with an always-visible overlay in the explorer.
problem: Seeing which files were recently changed normally requires opening a Recent Files tab, using hotkeys, or re-sorting the file explorer by modification date.
summary: File explorer overlay that marks each file with color-coded indicators showing how recently it was modified, up to 30 days.
